block.description: The report block's ID; empty for `--kind`.

csv.description: The CSV text when it goes to stdout; else `null`.

folios.description: For PDF: the folio labels of the block's pages written, in page order; `null` for CSV and XLSX.

out.description: The file written (`--out`); `null` for CSV on stdout.

preset.description: The CSV preset (`ew`, `excel-nl`, `excel-en`, `rfc4180`); `null` for XLSX and PDF (WP-S3.08 TX-7).

rev.description: The session revision the rows or pages were read at.

rows.description: For CSV and XLSX: the rows (data and heading rows, the header line excluded); `null` for PDF.
